title: Workload Identity Migration
description: Migrate workload identity: create service account, migrate pods, verify, remove old credentials

steps.description: Identify all workloads using static service account keys; document permissions and usage patterns
Create workload identity-enabled service account with equivalent IAM roles
Annotate Kubernetes service accounts with iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account binding
Rolling restart of all annotated deployments; pods inherit workload identity
Confirm pods authenticate via metadata server, not static keys; run integration tests for each workload
Delete static service account keys from Secret Manager and GCP IAM; confirm no workload depends on them
Recreate static keys, re-annotate pods to use key-based auth, restore secrets

checks: All annotated pods authenticate via workload identity (metadata server)
Zero pods fail auth after rolling restart
Integration tests pass for all migrated workloads
Static keys count drops to 0 for migrated SAs
Audit log confirms no static key usage post-migration
verification.success_criteria: 100% of target workloads authenticated via workload identity with zero regression

rollback_plan.trigger_condition: Any workload fails authentication after migration OR integration test failure rate > 0%
steps: Recreate static service account keys from backup
Restore Secret Manager secrets with static keys
Rolling restart pods to revert to static key auth
